text.autoconfig.itemframecontainer.title: ItemFrame Container Opener
text.autoconfig.itemframecontainer.optio:
When enabled, right-clicking item frames with items will open containers behind them.

- Hold Shift + Right Click to rotate items
- Left Click to take items
- Works with all vanilla containers
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.through-i: A lightweight client-side mod that allows you to open containers behind item frames with a simple right-click.
